about: The news bank for the „იუმორი" category (ported on 2026-10-31 from phase 2, tag before-rollback-1030): true, dated, sourced car news, a humour film's twist (tools/ci/humor.mjs NEWS_BANK, tools/ci/news.mjs). A STATIC SNAPSHOT of the bank phase 2's banks.yml wrote on 2026-10-28 (Georgian sources first, never politics, crime, crashes with victims or private people; an item kept only with 1 primary source or 2 independent ones, every fact re-fetched by a separate verify request). banks.yml and tools/ci/banks/ were NOT ported (a weekly job on the API credit): nothing refreshes this file, so the items expire on their "useUntil" and a humour film then stops before the writer (news_bank) until new verified items are added. The two Toyota items were dropped (the owner, 2026-10-29: no Toyota anywhere). Fields: id, lane "news", status fact|claim|demo, who, eventDate, published, useUntil, sources[{url, publisher, date}], facts_en[], figures[], ka{lines, twist, kicker}, hinges[], setups[], georgia, usedBy[].

facts_en: On 8 October 2026 Netgazeti reported that diesel in Georgia had gone above 5 GEL per litre. It called this an all-time record for the country.
Netgazeti says that over one year petrol rose by 35% (about 1.15 GEL a litre) and diesel by 65% (about 1.95 GEL a litre).
Netgazeti, using Wissol's price archive: in September 2012, premium petrol cost 2.28 GEL and diesel cost about the same.

ერთ წელში დიზელი 65 პროცენტით გაძვირდა, ბენზინი 35-ით.

A record nobody wanted to break
Comparing a 2012 receipt with a 2026 one

facts_en: Georgia exported 4,336 cars worth $149.59 million to Azerbaijan in January-September 2026, which makes it Georgia's third-biggest car export market.
That is 12.3% less by value and 32% less by number than a year earlier.
In September alone, 533 cars worth $21.13 million went to Azerbaijan. That is 46% more by value but 18.5% fewer cars than in September 2025.

setups: Fewer cars but bigger price tags

facts_en: Iran took 7,380 Georgian cars worth about $130 million ($129.7M) in January-September 2026.
That puts Iran in the top 10 buyers of Georgian car exports, with an increase of 18,600% on last year, according to OC Media.
Car exports to Armenia and Turkmenistan also rose.

წელს 9 თვეში 7 380 მანქანა წავიდა, 130 მილიონი დოლარის.

facts_en: Volvo Car USA is recalling 9,930 vehicles: 2025-2026 EX30 and 2026 EX30 Cross Country. autoevolution splits this into 8,825 EX30 and 1,105 EX30 Cross Country.
The head restraint cushion may come off in a crash, which raises the risk of injury.
Dealers will apply adhesive to hold the cushion on better, for free. Recall R10396, NHTSA campaign 26V671.
setups: A high-tech EV service visit that ends with a tube of glue
A headrest that wants to leave before the driver does

facts_en: Porsche is recalling 548 more 2024 911 and 718 cars in the US because the center lock wheel bolt may break.
If the bolt breaks the wheel can come off. Owners are told not to drive the cars until they are repaired.

autoevolution says two reports of broken center locks led to this recall, which adds cars to an earlier one. Dealers will check the wheel fastening and replace badly made parts. The roundup gives NHTSA campaign 26V682.

facts_en: On 8 October some networks put diesel up by as much as 10 tetri in one day and petrol up by 2 to 6 tetri.
At Wissol, Eko Diesel went from 4.99 to 5.07 GEL and Euro Regular from 4.02 to 4.08 GEL.
At Gulf, G-Force Super went to 4.65 GEL and G-Force Euro Diesel to 4.99 GEL. At Portal, Euro Diesel went to 4.89 GEL.

facts_en: Geostat published Georgia's foreign trade figures for January to September 2026 on 19 October 2026.
From January to September 2026, Georgia re-exported 63,141 vehicles worth $1.5 billion. That is $475 million, or 24%, less than in the same period of 2025.
The drop comes from lower sales to Georgia's biggest car buyers: Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and Tajikistan.
Even so, passenger cars are still Georgia's top export, at about 24.9% of all exports.

setups: გამყიდველი რუსთავის ბაზრობაზე გამვლელებს მანქანაზე ელაპარაკება, ისინი კი ქვეყნის ექსპორტის მეოთხედზე საუბრობენ.

facts_en: Brodie Kostecki and Todd Hazelwood (Dick Johnson Racing, #17 Ford Mustang) won the 2026 Repco Bathurst 1000.
Leader Anton De Pasquale's Team 18 Chevrolet Camaro ran out of fuel on the last lap, and Kostecki passed him to take the win.
It is the pair's second Bathurst 1000 win together, after their 2024 win with Erebus Motorsport.
figures: lead lost on the final lap
